features.name: Scoring margin
features.definition: Own final score minus opponent final score, including overtime and the league-recorded shootout score.

features.name: Scoring for
features.definition: Own points or goals scored per completed game.

features.name: Scoring allowed
features.definition: Opponent points or goals scored per completed game.

features.name: Win rate
features.definition: Wins divided by completed games; tied games contribute zero wins and one game. This team-strength statistic differs from pick win rate.

features.name: First home game after 4+ away games
features.definition: Home at a non-neutral venue, immediately after at least four consecutive completed away games. Neutral-site games interrupt this strictly-away sequence. A schedule proxy, not proof of a family reunion or psychological state.

features.name: Consecutive away games before this game
features.definition: Number of immediately preceding completed non-neutral away games before the current game. A genuine home game or neutral-site game interrupts the sequence.

features.name: Days since a recorded home game
features.definition: Elapsed days in 24-hour units since the last completed non-neutral home game's start in this season. Missing until a home game has been observed. This does not establish days continuously away.

features.name: Genuine home venue
features.definition: One for a non-neutral home game, zero for an away or neutral-site game.

features.name: Previous-game blowout loss
features.definition: The preceding completed game was lost by at least NBA 20 points, NFL 21 points or NHL 5 goals; missing before the first recorded result.

features.name: Lost the previous meeting this season
features.definition: The last completed meeting against this opponent in the same season was a loss; missing when there is no earlier meeting. This records a situation, not a measured revenge emotion.

features.name: First games under a new coach
features.definition: Require an official change date and a definition of first one, three or another fixed number of games. No invented motivational boost.

features.name: Predeclared rivalry matchup
features.definition: Maintain a rivalry list before evaluating outcomes. Membership is a contextual label, not evidence of extra effort.

features.name: Clinched or eliminated before the game
features.definition: Use a verified status known before the game. Do not infer motivation from a final-season table.

features.name: Publicly announced team milestone
features.definition: Require a dated public source and an observable definition. Do not collect private family or relationship information.

features.name: Rest days (off by default)
features.definition: Elapsed full days between games. Not selected by default because the owner does not prioritize it.

features.name: Distance between game venues
features.definition: Requires verified venue coordinates; straight-line venue distance is not an actual itinerary.

features.name: Time-zone change between venues
features.definition: Requires actual venue/time-zone mapping; do not infer sleep or jet lag directly.

features.name: Confirmed player absences
features.definition: Player-level status and observation time before game start; separate confirmed out from questionable. Any impact estimate must be trained only on this season.

features.name: Starting lineup continuity
features.definition: Share of starting roles retained from the preceding game. Requires reliable starters and timestamps; future confirmed starters cannot be backfilled into earlier forecasts.

features.name: Effective shooting percentage
features.definition: (Field goals made + 0.5 times made threes) divided by field-goal attempts. Pool numerator and denominator across each window.

features.name: Three-point attempt share
features.definition: Three-point attempts divided by all field-goal attempts.

features.name: Three-point shooting percentage
features.definition: Made threes divided by attempted threes; pool attempts rather than averaging game percentages.

features.name: Two-point shooting percentage
features.definition: Made two-point shots divided by attempted two-point shots.

features.name: Free-throw attempt rate
features.definition: Free-throw attempts divided by field-goal attempts; label this exact convention.

features.name: Free-throw percentage
features.definition: Free throws made divided by attempts.

features.name: Offensive rebound share
features.definition: Own offensive rebounds divided by own offensive rebounds plus opponent defensive rebounds.

features.name: Assists per made basket
features.definition: Assists divided by field goals made; this is not an official possession-based assist percentage.

features.name: Turnovers per game
features.definition: Team total turnovers; retain opponent and pace context when interpreting this count.

features.name: Fast-break scoring share
features.definition: Fast-break points divided by total points; this is scoring share, not transition-possession frequency.

features.name: Paint scoring share
features.definition: Paint points divided by total points.

features.name: Points from opponent turnovers
features.definition: Box-score points off turnovers; distinguish forced opportunities from shooting conversion.

features.name: Opponent effective shooting percentage
features.definition: Opponent adjusted made shots divided by opponent field-goal attempts.

features.name: Defensive rebound share
features.definition: Own defensive rebounds divided by own defensive rebounds plus opponent offensive rebounds.

features.name: Opponent turnovers
features.definition: Opponent total turnovers; not every turnover is caused by pressure from the defense.

features.name: Opponent free-throw attempt rate
features.definition: Opponent free-throw attempts divided by opponent field-goal attempts.

features.name: Opponent paint scoring share
features.definition: Opponent paint points divided by opponent total points.

features.name: Opponent fast-break scoring share
features.definition: Opponent fast-break points divided by opponent total points.

features.name: Steals per game
features.definition: Official steals; interpret with opponent possession opportunities.

features.name: Blocks per game
features.definition: Official blocked shots; a count is not equivalent to overall defensive value.

features.name: Possessions per game / pace
features.definition: Use verified possession counts and game length; distinguish raw pace from per-48-minute pace.

features.name: Points per 100 possessions
features.definition: 100 times points divided by actual possessions; do not import historically fitted possession estimates unnoticed.

features.name: Points allowed per 100 possessions
features.definition: 100 times opponent points divided by opponent possessions.

features.name: Shot-location mix
features.definition: Share of attempts at rim, other paint, midrange and three-point zones with explicit boundaries.

features.name: Offensive play-type mix
features.definition: Transition, isolation, pick-and-roll, spot-up and other documented categories; current endpoint access must be verified.

features.name: Bench minutes share
features.definition: Bench minutes divided by all player minutes; do not assume bench scoring alone measures bench quality.

features.name: Lineup scoring margins
features.definition: Possession-weighted scoring margin for identified five-player units; small samples and opponent context remain visible.

features.name: Close late-game performance
features.definition: Use a fixed clock/score definition declared before testing. Treat small samples as uncertain.

features.name: Completion percentage
features.definition: Completions divided by pass attempts; exclude sacks from the attempt denominator.

features.name: Passing yards per attempt
features.definition: Passing yards divided by pass attempts.

features.name: Net yards per dropback
features.definition: Pass and scramble yards minus sack yards, divided by a clearly defined dropback count.

features.name: Air yards per targeted attempt
features.definition: Total reported air yards divided by attempts with valid air-yards data; missing values are not zero.

features.name: Yards after catch per completion
features.definition: Yards after catch divided by completions with valid YAC data.

features.name: Early-down pass tendency
features.definition: Dropbacks divided by eligible first/second-down pass-or-run plays, with kneels/spikes excluded by a declared rule.

features.name: Explosive pass frequency
features.definition: Pass plays gaining at least 20 yards divided by eligible pass plays; threshold is a declared initial convention.

features.name: Sacks allowed per dropback
features.definition: Sacks divided by eligible dropbacks. This is not full pressure rate.

features.name: Quarterback hits allowed
features.definition: Reported QB hits divided by eligible dropbacks; unreported pressures are not treated as no pressure.

features.name: Rushing yards per carry
features.definition: Rushing yards divided by eligible carries, with QB kneels excluded.

features.name: Explosive rush frequency
features.definition: Rushes gaining at least 10 yards divided by eligible carries; threshold is a declared initial convention.

features.name: Rushes stopped at or behind the line
features.definition: Carries gaining zero or fewer yards divided by eligible carries.

features.name: First downs per eligible play
features.definition: Observed first-down conversions divided by eligible plays. Do not use EPA-defined success from a pretrained model.

features.name: Third-down conversion rate
features.definition: Observed third-down conversions divided by eligible third-down opportunities.

features.name: Red-zone drive touchdown rate
features.definition: Drives reaching the opponent 20-yard line and ending in a touchdown divided by qualifying drives.

features.name: Points per offensive drive
features.definition: Offensive drive points divided by eligible drives; separate end-half kneel drives.

features.name: Average starting field position
features.definition: Drive-start distance to the opponent goal line, with a consistent orientation.

features.name: Giveaways per game
features.definition: Interceptions thrown plus fumbles lost; distinguish opportunities and conversion luck in later analysis.

features.name: No-huddle frequency
features.definition: Eligible plays recorded as no-huddle divided by plays with that field available.

features.name: Shotgun frequency
features.definition: Eligible plays recorded as shotgun divided by plays with that field available.

features.name: Field-goal conversion by distance
features.definition: Made field goals divided by attempts in predeclared distance bins; extra points separate.

features.name: Net passing yards allowed per dropback
features.definition: Opponent net passing yards divided by opponent dropbacks.

features.name: Rushing yards allowed per carry
features.definition: Opponent rushing yards divided by eligible opponent carries.

features.name: Defensive sack rate
features.definition: Defensive sacks divided by opponent dropbacks.

features.name: Defensive QB-hit rate
features.definition: Reported defensive QB hits divided by opponent dropbacks; not full pressure rate.

features.name: Explosive plays allowed
features.definition: Passes of at least 20 yards and rushes of at least 10 yards divided by eligible opponent plays.

features.name: Red-zone touchdowns allowed
features.definition: Opponent red-zone drives ending in touchdowns divided by eligible opponent red-zone drives.

features.name: Takeaways per game
features.definition: Interceptions caught plus opponent fumbles recovered.

features.name: Man/zone and coverage tendencies
features.definition: Requires a verified current-season charting source; the documented public participation release is after the season.

features.name: Full pressure rate
features.definition: Requires verified pressures beyond sacks and hits; cannot fill missing pressures with zeros.

features.name: Routes and separation by route
features.definition: Requires current-season route charting/tracking coverage and permission to use it.

features.name: Our current-season expected points
features.definition: Train and validate a new expected-points model on only this season's earlier raw plays. Do not load nflfastR's pretrained EPA, CPOE or win-probability columns as features.

features.name: Shots on goal per game
features.definition: Official shots on goal for the team, excluding shootout attempts.

features.name: Shots on goal allowed
features.definition: Opponent shots on goal, excluding shootout attempts.

features.name: Shot-attempt share
features.definition: Own shots on goal, misses and blocked attempts divided by both teams' attempts; verify event ownership for blocks.

features.name: Unblocked shot-attempt share
features.definition: Own shots on goal and misses divided by both teams' unblocked attempts.

features.name: Average unblocked-shot distance
features.definition: Calculate from raw rink coordinates and attacking direction; do not import historically fitted venue corrections.

features.name: Unblocked-shot angle distribution
features.definition: Compute shot angles from raw coordinates and the goal location; retain coverage counts.

features.name: Shot-type mix
features.definition: Wrist, slap, backhand, tip, deflection and other recorded types.

features.name: Shots shortly after another shot
features.definition: Predeclare a time/ownership rule, such as a same-team shot within three seconds. Label this a sequence proxy, not verified rebound tracking.

features.name: Event-sequence rush proxy
features.definition: Needs a validated event/time/zone rule. Public play-by-play does not fully observe puck possession or pre-shot passes.

features.name: Shooting percentage
features.definition: Goals divided by shots on goal; exclude shootouts and identify empty-net contexts.

features.name: Five-on-five shot rate
features.definition: Shots divided by verified five-on-five minutes; separate offense and defense.

features.name: Five-on-five goal rate
features.definition: Goals divided by verified five-on-five minutes; separate offense and defense.

features.name: Power-play conversion
features.definition: Power-play goals divided by official opportunities; distinguish this from goals per power-play minute.

features.name: Penalty-kill success
features.definition: Killed official opponent power plays divided by eligible opportunities.

features.name: Penalties taken and drawn
features.definition: Separate penalties taken/drawn and actual strength-changing penalties from coincidental penalties.

features.name: Faceoff win percentage
features.definition: Faceoffs won divided by recorded faceoffs taken; optionally split by zone.

features.name: Goalie save percentage
features.definition: Saves divided by shots faced by the identified goalie, excluding empty-net and shootout situations.

features.name: Goalie shots faced and appearances
features.definition: Current-season shots faced and games started, with confirmed versus projected starter kept separate.

features.name: Empty-net scoring exposure
features.definition: Scoring and shot events with a goalie absent, separated from normal play.

features.name: Line and pairing usage
features.definition: Requires reliable current-season shift/ice-time data; do not infer line combinations from roster membership alone.

features.name: Our current-season shot-quality model
features.definition: Fit a restrained shot-goal model only on earlier current-season raw shots. Published MoneyPuck/hockeyR xG and goalie goals-saved-above-expected use outside training and are not imported.

nba_box.name: ESPN NBA box scores; representative response checked

nba_detail.name: NBA endpoint documentation; reliable access still needed

nba_pbp.name: Possession and lineup reconstruction; access still needed

nfl_pbp.name: nflverse raw 2026 play-by-play; exclude pretrained derived columns

nfl_injuries.name: nflverse 2026 injury reports; timestamp coverage required

nfl_charting.name: Detailed participation is not a dependable public in-season source

nhl_pbp.name: NHL current-season game play-by-play; representative response checked
